# Agentrix

> Agentrix is an agentic AI agency that builds autonomous AI agents which think, organize themselves, and take action to give businesses back their time.

## What we do

- Workflow automation — end-to-end automation of recurring tasks (follow-ups, data entry, reports, syncing between tools), running continuously without oversight.
- Scraping & qualified leads — agents that find, enrich, and qualify prospects at scale, feeding CRM pipelines with contacts that matter.
- High-conversion websites — modern, fast, SEO-optimized websites designed, built, and delivered end-to-end.
- Reasoning agents — agents that break down complex goals, plan, decide, and adapt to business rules, with optional human validation.

- [Home](https://www.agentrix-ia.com/): Overview of Agentrix and what our autonomous AI agents do.
- [Product](https://www.agentrix-ia.com/#product): The Agentrix agent platform and its capabilities.
